title: LAOWANG
description: A caustic and imaginative spin on King Lear that explores the changing face of America's Chinatowns and the fight to preserve a fading cultural memory. The story follows A-Poh, a Chinese grandma, as she gathers her grandchildren to save her restaurant from a high-rise developer, all while dealing with her fading memory.
address: 59E59 Theaters – a quick block from SUBWAY 4/5/6 N/W/R at 59 St.
